mapper.select: SELECT u.workspace_id AS key, COALESCE(w.name, u.workspace_id, '') AS name, COALESCE(SUM(u.prompt_tokens), 0) AS "promptTokens", COALESCE(SUM(u.completion_tokens), 0) AS "completionTokens", COALESCE(SUM(u.cost_micros), 0) AS "costMicros", COUNT(*) AS calls FROM model_usage u LEFT JOIN sys_workspace w ON w.id = u.workspace_id WHERE (#{workspaceId}::varchar IS NULL OR u.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) AND u.create_at >= #{from} AND u.create_at <= #{to} AND u.workspace_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.workspace_id, w.name ORDER BY "costMicros" DESC

SELECT u.agent_id AS key, COALESCE(a.name, u.agent_id, '') AS name, COALESCE(SUM(u.prompt_tokens), 0) AS "promptTokens", COALESCE(SUM(u.completion_tokens), 0) AS "completionTokens", COALESCE(SUM(u.cost_micros), 0) AS "costMicros", COUNT(*) AS calls FROM model_usage u LEFT JOIN agent_agent a ON a.id = u.agent_id WHERE (#{workspaceId}::varchar IS NULL OR u.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) AND u.create_at >= #{from} AND u.create_at <= #{to} AND u.agent_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.agent_id, a.name ORDER BY "costMicros" DESC

SELECT u.user_id AS key, COALESCE(au.display_name, u.user_id, '') AS name, COALESCE(SUM(u.prompt_tokens), 0) AS "promptTokens", COALESCE(SUM(u.completion_tokens), 0) AS "completionTokens", COALESCE(SUM(u.cost_micros), 0) AS "costMicros", COUNT(*) AS calls FROM model_usage u LEFT JOIN auth_user au ON au.id::text = u.user_id WHERE (#{workspaceId}::varchar IS NULL OR u.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) AND u.create_at >= #{from} AND u.create_at <= #{to} AND u.user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.user_id, au.display_name ORDER BY "costMicros" DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(u.binding_id, ''), u.model_ref) AS key, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.model_ref, ''), u.binding_id, '') AS name, COALESCE(SUM(u.prompt_tokens), 0) AS "promptTokens", COALESCE(SUM(u.completion_tokens), 0) AS "completionTokens", COALESCE(SUM(u.cost_micros), 0) AS "costMicros", COUNT(*) AS calls FROM model_usage u WHERE (#{workspaceId}::varchar IS NULL OR u.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) AND u.create_at >= #{from} AND u.create_at <= #{to} AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.binding_id, ''), u.model_ref) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(u.binding_id, ''), u.model_ref), COALESCE(NULLIF(u.model_ref, ''), u.binding_id, '') ORDER BY "costMicros" DESC

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('day', u.create_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, COALESCE(SUM(u.prompt_tokens), 0) AS "promptTokens", COALESCE(SUM(u.completion_tokens), 0) AS "completionTokens", COALESCE(SUM(u.cost_micros), 0) AS "costMicros", COUNT(*) AS calls FROM model_usage u WHERE (#{workspaceId}::varchar IS NULL OR u.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) AND u.create_at >= #{from} AND u.create_at <= #{to} AND ( (#{scopeType} = 'workspace' AND u.workspace_id = #{scopeId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'agent' AND u.agent_id = #{scopeId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'user' AND u.user_id = #{scopeId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'model' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.binding_id, ''), u.model_ref) = #{scopeId}) ) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS "promptTokens", COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS "completionTokens", COALESCE(SUM(cost_micros), 0) AS "costMicros", COUNT(*) AS calls FROM model_usage WHERE thread_id = #{threadId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) FROM model_usage WHERE create_at >= #{from} AND create_at < #{to} AND ( (#{scopeType} = 'workspace' AND workspace_id = #{scopeId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'user' AND user_id = #{scopeId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'agent' AND agent_id = #{scopeId}) )
